tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Research providers FinChiefs follows (banks, asset managers, central banks, multilaterals, independent researchers). Use the id to limit other tools to one provider.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Asset digest categories (gold, oil, us_bonds, eurusd, …) and macro categories (monetary_policy, geopolitics, …). Keys with has_daily_digest work with get_daily_digests; macro keys also filter search_macro_views and summarize_views.

tools.name: summarize_views
tools.description: The overall picture from EVERY matching view in one small response: totals, up/down counts (asset views), how many providers lean each way, the busiest providers, a week-by-week trend, and the most-discussed assets or macro categories. Start here for "what is the consensus / how has it changed" ques

tools.name: search_asset_views
tools.description: Individual directional views (up/down) on assets, with provider, date, horizon, rationale and a link to the source publication. Up/down tallies cover every match; items come in pages (offset / next_offset), spread across providers by default. For the overall picture, call summarize_views first.

tools.name: search_macro_views
tools.description: Individual macro themes and drivers from provider research (growth, inflation, policy, fiscal, geopolitics, …), each with a description and a link to the source publication. Items come in pages (offset / next_offset), spread across providers by default. For counts and trends, call summarize_views fi

tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Research publications (articles, reports, podcasts) with title, provider, date, a short description and the link to the original. Ranked by how well the terms match (title matches count most), then newest; pages via offset / next_offset. Follow the link for the full text where the publisher allows i

tools.name: get_daily_digests
tools.description: Daily summaries written from all providers' views for a category (e.g. gold, oil, us_bonds, top macro themes, policy makers), with the day's up/down tallies. Good for how a view changed day by day. Category keys (has_daily_digest) come from list_categories.

tools.name: get_policy_signals
tools.description: Structured reads of central-bank and multilateral publications: decisions, stance (-2 dovish to +2 hawkish), guidance, conditions, speaker and forecasts, each with a link to the original. Newest first; pages via offset / next_offset.
